Finance at Syndeo has one ask before we activate the first PO: can you confirm Redwood's supported billing windows and whether our AP team can opt into an accelerated payment plan (we typically run Net-60, but are open to Net-30 / Net-45). Hi Emma — thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front: Redwood supports Net-30, Net-45, and Net-60. Our default for new customers is Net-45, but we can:

- Set Net-30 for accounts that need tighter cadence.
- Enable an "Accelerated Payment" program (third-party-managed or in-house ACH settlement) for specific invoices with an agreed fee / discount structure.

Action items I need from you to move the vendor setup along:
1) Signed W9 (got it — thanks).
2) Completed PO (I attached a Redwood PO template for your AP to populate).
3) Banking or payment preference form if you want ACH settlement.

I'm cc'ing Laura from Finance to confirm the discount structure for early-pay pilots and to share enrollment paperwork. Aditya — flagging this as a potential pilot for the 1.5% early-pay offer for first 90 days to accelerate onboarding; can we discuss?

I'll also note our required remittance email for POs/invoices: invoices@redwood-invoice.com and the legal entity to list on the PO is Redwood Inference, Inc.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if Syndeo wants to walk through the forms.

Best,
Chlo Martin
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & payment cadence question

All — finance here. A few specifics and requirements to keep things clean:

1) Standard terms we offer: Net-30 (preferred for smaller vendors), Net-45 (default for new accounts), Net-60 (by exception).
2) Early-pay program options:
   - "Discounted EarlyPay": Redwood pays within 7-14 days for a vendor-discount (we typically accept 1–2% depending on volume).
   - "Accelerated Remit" (via our payments partner): payment within 3 business days after invoice approval; requires vendor enrollment and ACH + tax form on file.
3) Enrollment steps (what Syndeo must provide):
   - Signed W9 and vendor contact details (done).
   - Completed PO with Redwood entity and remittance email (Chlo provided template).
   - Banking document or voided check for ACH (required for Accelerated Remit).
   - Signed EarlyPay addendum (I can send via DocuSign).
4) Routing: Please have Syndeo email invoices to invoices@redwood-invoice.com and include the PO number in the subject line. For accelerated requests, cc: earlypay@redwood.com.

If we're offering a 1.5% pilot for 90 days, we need the PO to state the discount window and the invoices to include the PO number and discount code: EP-90-9821. I'll prepare the DocuSign packet (EarlyPay addendum + vendor enrollment form) and share the link.

TL;DR: Finance is good with the 1.5% / 90-day pilot if Syndeo provides ACH and signs the addendum.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Director, Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
attachments: EarlyPay_Addendum.pdf (to be sent via DocuSign)
